en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street corner with a prominent two‑storey traditional European building labeled "Hotel zum Stern". The structure has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, flower boxes beneath the windows, and signage for the hotel, wine shop, and restaurant on the ground floor. A man in formal clothing stands on the sidewalk near the corner entrance, and an early 20th‑century car is parked in front. The caption at the top reads "Neustadt i. Sa.  Hotel zum Stern".
